title: 2027 JSPS-UNU Postdoctoral Fellowship Programme
institution: United Nations University Institute for the Advanced Study of Sustainability (UNU-IAS)
level: Postdoctoral (doctorate held or expected by end of July 2027)
about: UNU-IAS in Tokyo will accept applications for the 2027 JSPS-UNU Postdoctoral Fellowship Programme from 1 December 2026. Fellowships last 24 months and must begin in Japan by 30 November 2027. The deadline is 31 January 2027 (23:59 JST).
requirements: Doctorate at the time of application, or scheduled to receive one by the end of July 2027
Citizens of countries without diplomatic relations with Japan are not eligible
Fellows must begin in Japan by 30 November 2027

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Sustainability research" (field, postdoctoral fellowship) → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Doctorate at the time of application" (research-level profile) → "Apply responsible practices for verification, attribution, citation awareness, confidentiality, and academic integrity when using AI in research activities."
